title: Road to a bigger chest
summary: He prefers a look where arms and shoulders overpower a slightly smaller chest, but the chest must still grow with the arms. His chest training is simple: bench press, push-ups and rings.

claims.claim: He likes a look where the chest is slightly smaller than the limbs, with arms and shoulders overpowering it.
As the arms grow the chest has to grow with them, otherwise you end up with a flat chest.
His chest training is very simple: bench press, push-ups and Olympic rings.
His chest has good thickness but his pec insertions are not ideal, leaving a gap between the pecs.
Chest is not the body part he is most excited about, but he loves bench pressing.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.why: main chest lift, he loves it
